/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import concurrent.futures
import json
import re
import subprocess

packet = json.load(open('packet.json'))

pack_seed = '''MATCH (pack:CRPack {crPackId:'PACK_ID'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(seed:Tdoc {type:'CR'})
MATCH (seed)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release)
MATCH (seed)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(decision:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus:'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(seed)
MATCH (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(:Meeting {workingGroup:'RAN1'})
WHERE release.releaseName IN RELEASE_NAMES
  AND spec.specRelease = release.releaseName
  AND decision.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '\\\"scope\\\": \\\"whole_target\\\"'
'''

latest_shape = pack_seed + '''WITH DISTINCT pack, release, section, spec
MATCH (previous:Tdoc {type:'CR'})-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section)
MATCH (previous)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release)
MATCH (previous)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(earlier:CRPack)
WHERE toInteger(replace(earlier.tsgMeeting,'RAN#','')) < toInteger(replace(pack.tsgMeeting,'RAN#',''))
WITH pack, release, section, spec, max(toInteger(replace(earlier.tsgMeeting,'RAN#',''))) AS latestMeeting
MATCH (previous:Tdoc {type:'CR'})-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section)
MATCH (previous)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release)
MATCH (previous)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(earlier:CRPack)
WHERE toInteger(replace(earlier.tsgMeeting,'RAN#','')) = latestMeeting
RETURN DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specification, section.sectionNumber AS clause, earlier.crPackId AS cr_pack, earlier.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting'''

first_shape = pack_seed + '''WITH DISTINCT pack, seed, release, section, spec
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  MATCH (previous:Tdoc {type:'CR'})-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section)
  MATCH (previous)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release)
  MATCH (previous)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(earlier:CRPack)
  WHERE toInteger(replace(earlier.tsgMeeting,'RAN#','')) < toInteger(replace(pack.tsgMeeting,'RAN#',''))
}
RETURN DISTINCT seed.tdocNumber AS document, spec.specNumber AS specification, section.sectionNumber AS clause'''

same_clause_shape = '''MATCH (seed:Tdoc {type:'CR',tdocNumber:'DOCUMENT_ID'})-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release)
MATCH (seed)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE release.releaseName IN RELEASE_NAMES
  AND spec.specRelease = release.releaseName
  AND spec.specNumber = 'SPEC_NUMBER'
MATCH (other:Tdoc {type:'CR'})-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section)
MATCH (other)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release)
MATCH (other)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack)
MATCH (resolution:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(decision:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus:'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(other)
MATCH (resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(meeting:Meeting {workingGroup:'RAN1'})
WHERE other.tdocNumber <> seed.tdocNumber
  AND decision.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '\\\"scope\\\": \\\"whole_target\\\"'
RETURN DISTINCT section.sectionNumber AS clause, other.tdocNumber AS document, decision.dispositionCode AS disposition, meeting.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting, pack.crPackId AS cr_pack'''

queries = []
shape_counts = {}
for item in packet['items']:
    question = item['question']
    releases = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'Rel-\\d+', question)))
    release_names = '[' + ', '.join(\"'\" + value + \"'\" for value in releases) + ']'
    if question.startswith('Change request '):
        shape = 'same_clause'
        document = re.search(r'R1-\\d+', question).group()
        specification = re.search(r'to TS ([0-9.]+)', question).group(1)
        query = same_clause_shape.replace('DOCUMENT_ID', document).replace('SPEC_NUMBER', specification)
    else:
        pack = re.search(r'RP-\\d+', question).group()
        shape = 'first' if 'changes first' in question else 'latest_earlier'
        query = (first_shape if shape == 'first' else latest_shape).replace('PACK_ID', pack)
    query = query.replace('RELEASE_NAMES', release_names)
    columns = re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+(\\w+)', query.rsplit('RETURN DISTINCT ', 1)[1], flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    assert columns == item['fields'], (item['id'], columns, item['fields'])
    queries.append({'id': item['id'], 'cypher': query})
    shape_counts[shape] = shape_counts.get(shape, 0) + 1

assert len(queries) == 60
assert len({entry['id'] for entry in queries}) == 60
